data.completion_memo: Removed the Chat continuation recompile/re-freeze and frozen-authority equality gate. Continued input and Stop/Continue copy the original persisted snapshot, manifest, provider, tool bindings, workspace and MCP metadata, creating fresh pass identities/working state and applying new messages, controls and explicit Chat approval mode. Echoed desktop configuration no longer changes or blocks a saved Chat. Duplicate-command validation now compares actual input/control payload and Chat/Run ownership only; action permissions, workspace dispatch boundaries and effect deduplication remain intact. Added exact legacy subagent descriptor support at dispatch while retaining its original read-only child scope and argument validation. Reproduced the exact reported error before the fix using a read-only exported prepared record from chat.dd65c40d9352c31bdabdf7a4d24d9420db26e42e; the same captured continuation now passes. Standard desktop backend suite: 365 passed, 0 failed, 1 diagnostic test ignored; explicitly ran that captured-record diagnostic separately: 1 passed. Behavioral regressions execute legacy/current subagents through approval and actual file-tool dispatch, metadata-independent continuation, Stop/Continue and replay without duplicate effects. All providers were scripted: no paid API calls and no live history mutations. Critical task/design audit passed against snapshot_freezer revision659 and subagent scope. Optimized aworkit-desktop.exe built successfully with one existing main.rs unused_mut warning; git diff --check passed. Updated docs/subagent-tool-inheritance.md. No frontend change or frontend rebuild.
data.description: Use the persisted Chat snapshot directly for continued input and Stop/Continue. Remove the recompile/re-freeze and frozen-authority equality blocker. Echoed desktop metadata must not mutate saved authority or block continuation. Create only fresh pass state/message controls and retain action-level permissions, Chat ownership and effect deduplication. Reproduce and verify the user's saved Chat with no paid provider call or live-history modification. Preserve known legacy subagent dispatch and build an updated executable.
data.title: Preserve frozen Chat authority when native tool contracts change
